notes.title: Bugs Finally Fixed
notes.notes:
first off, thanks for being patient up to now.

i don't wanna sound pitiful, but i'm only 15 and working solo, so spotting and fixing bugs is kinda tricky for me.

still, the game is all set and ready to be played and enjoyed the way it should be.

once again, thanks for your patience and for reporting bugs.

notes.title: Home Deception Now On Sale!
notes.notes:
[h1]Home Deception[/h1]
A teen's grandma got sick, but his mother couldn't go take care of her, so he did. It turns out that taking care of her [b]is the least of his worries[/b], though.

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3163910/extras/gif1__2___1_.gif?t=1725354761[/img]

Home Deception is a short game based on the [b]psychological horror[/b] of a situation that simulates real life.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
This game includes an immersive experience made by the conversation, computer, walking and more mechanics.

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Realistic Atmosphere
[/list]
[list]
[*] Conversations with NPCs 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Computer Mechanic 
[/list]
